description: Change a mock's behaviour: default status, latency, jitter, error rate, persistent writes, and per route status, latency, hand-written bodies, rules. Merge semantics: missing keys are kept, null clears.

ownerToken.description: Owner token received at creation (not needed when the account is connected with an API token)

patch.description: Same fields as PATCH /mocks/:slug/behavior: a missing key is kept, null clears

activeScenario.description: Scenario applied to every request without an x-loutre-scenario header; null deactivates

errorRate.description: Share of requests that return an error

graphqlPath.description: GraphQL mocks only: the path the endpoint answers on, /graphql by default (e.g. /api/graphql); null restores /graphql

proxy.description: Base URL of a real backend: routes the schema does not describe are forwarded there; null removes

bodies.description: Status → hand-written JSON body; null removes

rules.description: Conditional rules (see add_rule); the list replaces the existing one

scenarios.description: Named bundles of settings (same fields as this patch minus scenarios and proxy), applied per request with the x-loutre-scenario header or with activeScenario; null removes

status.description: Forced status for the whole mock; null to remove

name: set_behavior
